about.title: We sold the same starter twice and never wrote the proposal again.
about.p1: Pixelforge is a small studio that ships web systems in two-week cycles. We noticed every client kept describing the same software: bookings, a CRM, an admin, payments. So we built those once — really well — and now we re-skin them.
about.p2: That means lower price, faster launch, and code that's been battle-tested across dozens of projects rather than written from zero on yours. We still tailor it: your colors, your data, your integrations. Only the boring stuff stays the same.

goal.title: Single goal
goal.body: Ship a working system, not a deck. Every meeting drives toward a staging link.

team.title: Six people
team.body: Two designers, three engineers, one PM. You'll know all six by name.

speed.title: Two weeks
speed.body: Average from kickoff to launch. Larger scope still ships in 6-8 weeks.

steps.label: Pick a demo.
steps.body: Browse the gallery, open one in your browser, share with stakeholders. If something isn't there, tell us and we'll either add it or scope it as bespoke.

steps.label: 20-minute brief.
steps.body: One call, one shared doc. We finalize palette, copy, integrations, and the first three things we're cutting from your wishlist.

steps.label: Daily staging.
steps.body: You get a link that updates every day. Comment inline, we ship the same afternoon.

steps.label: Launch + 60 days.
steps.body: Production go-live and bug fixes for free. After that we offer a flat monthly retainer.

services.title: What we actually do
services.lede: Every project includes the bullets below. Pick the ones you need on the quote; we'll skip the rest.

branding.title: Brand + UI tailoring
branding.body: We re-skin one of our demos to your palette, typography, and tone. Includes a 30-page design review.

hosting.title: Hosting + deployment
hosting.body: We ship to Vercel, your VPS, or your existing cloud. SSL, domains, backups — handled.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Stripe, payment.tj, Telegram bot, WhatsApp Business, Twilio, your accounting software, REST/GraphQL APIs.

data.title: Custom data model
data.body: Need fields the demo doesn't have? We add them, with admin UI and proper validation, in the first week.

i18n.title: Multi-language
i18n.body: Russian and Tajik built in. We can add Uzbek, Arabic, or any RTL language with a day of localization.

compliance.title: Compliance + audit
compliance.body: GDPR-ready data export, role-based access control, audit log, and a security report on launch.

services.ctaLede: Open a demo, tell us what's missing. We'll send a quote in 24 hours.
